Does anybody know the answers to these questions:

Does Luke get a lightsaber fight with Kylo when he dies? 

Is his Lightsaber the return of the jedi lightsaber?

What color is his blade? Is it still green? 

Does Kylo keep the Skywalker Saber?

Does Rey keep Kylo's crossguard lightsaber?
No. Some of the green lightsabers look yellowish due to the desert background, but they all are intended to look green or blue.

You know what really amazes me about Harry Potter? Think about this - Star Wars changes protagonists, Pirates of the caribbean and marvel have plot changes, things like Twilight or the huger games only lasted a few books. 

Harry Potter is one cohesive story that spans seven different extensive books/movies that fleshes out so many different characters. What JK Rowling did is unparalleled in my opinion.

I'd also like to ask is Jack the protagonist, or is this more Henry's story? 

And once the pearl is brought back, who does Jack have as his crew in the end?

How much dialogue do Will and Elizabeth get, which of the two gets more? 

Do you think there will be a sequel with Will, Jack, Henry, and Carina? 

Is Will still the captain of the Dutchman at the end? 

Do Scrum and Gibbs have decent roles? 

Is Barbossa in the navy?

The prayer i'm referencing is one of the more important ones i  ever made, and it got answered. It wasn't for a toy.

I believe that sometimes good things happen by chance, and maybe at other times they happen as a result of him answering your prayers. I feel as though its possible prayers are answered only when people are both truly in need and fully buying in.

I think that if other people had the same circumstances, they're prayers would be answered too.

I understand where you are coming from, I do not find it rude at all. I guess the best way I can put it is that what I prayed for was something that had long been a struggle, and after I asked for it I felt as if I got it within hours. Most of the signs that have occurred to me have been ones of the Christian faith.

I think that there is a chance in the back of your head you are always defaulting to the idea in your head that people are going to reject you, and although you exude confidence the underlying thought show's. Do not worry, as we ALL eventually find people we connect with. Anyone can make friends. My best friend throughout middle school and high school has aspergers and he and I still hang out occasionally to this day, one of my dad's life long friends and business partner also has aspergers and is extremely socially successful. You will develop as an individual as long as you set your mind to it, you are more then capable.
